name: Flaky Test Tracker
description: Tracks intermittent test failures across recent CI runs and highlights likely flaky tests.
tagline: Finds tests that pass and fail intermittently across recent CI runs.

ownedSettings.label: Flaky test tracker schedule
ownedSettings.description: Cron, model, prompt, and run parameters.

fields.label: CI run and test-report endpoints
fields.helpText: One HTTP(S) endpoint per line. Endpoints can be native APIs, internal exports, webhooks, or JSON/text snapshots.

fields.label: Bearer token env vars
fields.helpText: Comma-separated environment variable names. The first variable with a value is used as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Context notes
fields.placeholder: Flag tests or suites that fail intermittently, especially if later reruns pass. Include workflow, branch, and failure pattern.
fields.helpText: Optional instructions, priorities, account names, or pasted context to include in every run.

fields.label: Publish report to Item Bus
fields.helpText: When enabled, each run publishes the report as a dev.flaky-test-report item.

routes.label: Flaky Tests
routes.description: Tracks intermittent test failures across recent CI runs and highlights likely flaky tests.
